mentions.name: AppHaven
mentions.description: A hosting platform for AI-written apps that lets non-technical users deploy applications by asking AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex. The platform handles backups, login/access control, and vulnerability scanning, and ships a Claude Code plugin (under review at Anthropic, also installable from GitHub) for simple agent integration.
mentions.problem: Deploying AI-written apps is difficult for users without technical skills.
mentions.audience: Not-so-technical users who build apps with AI coding agents
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a hosting platform for AI-written apps: https://apphaven.eu/

The idea is to make it easier for not-so-technical users to ask their Claude Code or Codex (or similar) agent to deploy the app. And then the platform handles backups, login/access control, vulnerability scanning etc.
